main_body: Sci-fi building: a sloped metal roof panel (rows 1-16) over a front wall (rows 18-43) with two cyan windows, two dark windows and a central door
top_band: Roof slope at rows 1-16: light blue-grey (L 118-178) with panel seams and vents, ending in a light front-edge line at rows 15-17 (#a3b4cb, #c3cad2)
evidence: In the x=32 column the roof is a large lighter surface (rows 1-16, steps of #8396b2 and #a3b4cb) seen from above, with vents and seams on it and sloped corners at the sides. A light edge line sits at rows 15-17, then a dark row 18 under it and an orange fascia band at rows 19-23 act as the eave shadow. The wall below (rows 24-43) has a clearly different tone. The windows have dark inset frames with sills, and the door is recessed with an inner shadow. The roof and the front wall both read correctly, so the drawing is 3/4.

style.evidence: The roof has about 5 steps (#a3b4cb, #8396b2, #667896, #4f5f7a, dark seams), but the wall is mostly one flat #3c4452 with a few speckles and panel lines. The piece has only 29 distinct colours against 66 and 185 for the references. Per-tile colour count (10) is close to house-h112 (11) and below house-h101 (18). 76% of dark edge pixels are neutral, against 7-9% for the references, and the top outline row is near-black (#06070e). The references use tinted dark-material outlines, so this reads as a sticker-like outline with a thinner palette and less per-material texture than the Beodeul pieces.
